iconicAnchor.label: Illustrated historical board-game sheets
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Library's collection shows how printed game imagery can carry rules, play structure, and component behavior in one graphic artifact.

sources.title: Games for Fun and Relaxation
supports: Game graphics can integrate image, printed play surface, pieces, and rules into a coherent usable artifact.

sources.title: Dietrich Hecht collection of Bilderbogen
supports: Historical game sheets combine bright illustration, narrative frames, printed rules, boards, and cut-out play elements.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches shelf facing title, illustrated premise, component preview, player age cues, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/board-game-box/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
